data.description:
## Context / Problem
Inert-config class (281f, 9d7a family): a typed schema field ships with zero cfg.<section>.<field> read sites outside schema/config plumbing, so the knob silently does nothing. Env vars are already covered by the docs/env-vars.md drift gate; schema fields have no equivalent.

## Approach
Deterministic AST-level check: for each field in _config_schema.py, require >=1 attribute-read site (cfg.<section>.<field>) outside the schema/config plumbing modules. Escape hatch: '# read-via: <path-or-reason>' comment on the field for indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-project-only knobs) — pointer required, not a bare boolean. Fires ONLY on zero references (the bug condition), so refactors that move reads cannot FP. Failing message teaches the escape and cites in-file examples. Wire into CI alongside existing gates.

## Scope
- new check script (AST walk over src/rebar) + CI wiring
- '# read-via:' markers for any legitimately indirect current fields (enumerate at implementation; expected small)

## Testing
Unit: field with a read passes; field with zero reads fails naming the field; read-via marker with pointer passes; marker without pointer fails. Full-tree run clean at merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI fails when any schema field has zero read sites and no read-via marker; message teaches remediation.
- [ ] Marker requires a pointer/reason; bare markers rejected.
- [ ] Zero-reference-only firing (no change-detector behavior on refactors).
- [ ] Tree clean at landing with justified markers only.
data.title: Config-is-read DET check: every _config_schema.py field must have a read site
